cohort: The study cohort consisted of 131 deliveries of pregnant individuals who received amnioinfusion after 30 minutes of recurrent variable decelerations that continued despite intrauterine resuscitation.
finding: Amnioinfusion effectively reduced the Total Deceleration Area (TDA) in deliveries complicated with recurrent variable decelerations.
mod_finding: Among the deliveries, 44.3% resulted in vaginal delivery, 22.1% in vacuum extraction, and 33.6% in cesarean delivery, with CD patients having higher rates of nulliparity, meconium, and fever.
